description:
### basic math functions 

> need something else? look [here](https://mathjs.org/docs/index.html) 

#### arithmetic and rounding
* `add(a, b)` - addition of numbers matrices or units
* `subtract(a, b)` - subtraction
* `multiply(a, b)` - multiplication
* `divide(a, b)` - division
* `pow(x, y)` - power x to y
* `sqrt(x)` - square root supports negative numbers
* `mod(a, b)` - modulus remainder of division
* `round(x, n)` - round x to n decimals
* `ceil(x)` / `floor(x)` - round up / down to nearest integer

#### trigonometry and exponents
* `sin(x)` / `cos(x)` / `tan(x)` - sine cosine and tangent in radians
* `asin(x)` / `acos(x)` / `atan(x)` - inverse trigonometric functions
* `log(x, base)` - logarithm of x with custom base default is natural
* `log10(x)` - base 10 logarithm

#### statistics and combinatorics
* `sum(a, b, c...)` - sum of all arguments or array elements
* `mean(array)` - arithmetic mean of array
* `std(array)` - standard deviation
* `min(array)` / `max(array)` - minimum and maximum values
* `factorial(n)` - factorial of n
* `combinations(n, k)` - combinations of n choose k
* `permutations(n, k)` - permutations of n choose k
* `random(min, max)` - random number in range

#### algebra and parsing
* `evaluate(expr)` - evaluate an expression string e.g. 2 * (3 + 5)
* `simplify(expr)` - symbolic simplification e.g. 2x + x to 3 * x
* `derivative(expr, variable)` - find the derivative of an expression

#### constants
* `pi` - pi constant 3.14159...
* `e` - euler number 2.71828...
* `i` - imaginary unit for complex numbers
